{"consolidated_memory":"## Off-by-One Cent Issues in billing/invoice_totals.py

Component: billing/invoice_totals.py (billing side)
Stack: Python
Test coverage: tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py
Common signal: one cent gap in the reconciliation report
Common repro: total an invoice with three prorated lines

### Occasion 1: [2026-04-20]
**Trigger:** Race condition when two requests raced on the same key
**Root cause:** Error swallowed by a bare except handler
**Fix:** Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #4011 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1
**Result:** Job execution time improved from 8 hours to 19 minutes

### Occasion 2: [2026-05-12]
**Trigger:** Payloads above roughly two megabytes
**Root cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
**Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #9485 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
**Result:** Memory usage improved from climbing past 4 GB to settling at 88 MB

These represent two separate instances of off-by-one cent problems in the same component, with different root causes and fixes applied at different times."}
